How it works

  1. Give your leaderboard a name and choose your plus and minus buttons.
  2. Add players or teams — paste a whole list at once if you have one.
  3. Give points and the ranking updates itself. Press “End game” to show the podium.

Why Punkto

Always sorted by points

The leaderboard re-ranks itself after every change, with gold, silver and bronze for the top three.

Rounds

Track points per round and see a round-by-round table, on your screen and on the big display.

Readable with 40 names

The display view sizes itself so every name stays readable, even on a projector at the back of the room.

Private by design: names and scores are stored only in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

Questions & answers

How many players can a leaderboard have?

As many as you need. The display arranges them in columns, so around 40 names stay readable on one screen.

Is my leaderboard saved?

Yes, automatically, in your browser on this device. Export a file or copy a backup link to move it to another device.

Can I change points afterwards?

Yes. Use the minus buttons or undo, edit any round in the rounds table, or click a score and type the correct number.
